landing_title: Your sleep and training, in one dashboard
landing_subtitle: Import your Sleep Cycle and Hevy exports and discover how your rest and your workouts affect each other.
landing_feature_sleep_desc: Quality, time in bed, regularity and notes from your Sleep Cycle exports.
landing_feature_training_desc: Volume, sets and progression for every exercise from your Hevy workouts.
landing_feature_correlations_desc: See how training days and your habits impact your sleep quality.
notes_impact_footnote: Colored differences are larger than normal night-to-night variation; grey ones may just be chance.
empty_desc: Import your Sleep Cycle and Hevy CSV exports to fill your dashboard.
exercises_empty: Import your Hevy data to track your progress per exercise.
ex_weight_desc: Max weight lifted in each session
ex_volume_desc: Total kg lifted in each session
import_desc: Connect automatic data sources or upload CSV files. Records that already exist are skipped, so you can import safely.
import_sleep_desc: CSV export from Sleep Cycle (semicolon separated)
import_error: Could not read the file. Make sure it is the original CSV export.
google_health_description: Automatically import health and fitness data from your Google account.
google_health_not_connected_description: Connect Google Health to import supported metrics automatically.
google_health_connecting_description: Your Google Health connection is ready. The first import will start shortly.
google_health_importing_description: You can leave this page while HomeFit continues importing in the background.
google_health_partial_access_description: Review Google Health access to include every supported metric.
google_health_delayed_description: HomeFit will retry automatically. Your imported data remains available.

google_health_retained_description: Automatic imports are stopped, but your previously imported Google Health data remains available.

google_health_error_description: We could not load this connection. Try again shortly.

google_health_feedback_disconnected: Google Health disconnected. Imported data was retained.
google_health_action_error: The Google Health action could not be completed. Please try again.

health_categories_description: Browse every imported measurement by health category.
health_recent_description: The latest activity and exercise measurements in your account.
health_all_metrics_description: Every metric imported from Google Health, including complex records.
